capabilities: Show full file paths for backlinks in the Backlinks pane
Distinguish notes that share the same name
Open a bundled demo vault from a command
extras: Documentation is a demo vault with three same-named notes, available via a command, a release zip or the repository; beta versions install through BRAT; debug messages are hidden by default.
intentEvidence: Full paths in the Backlinks pane, so notes sharing a name are distinguishable — shown side by side with Obsidian's default.
motivation: The author keeps same-named notes such as a Meeting note in several project folders and found the identical backlink rows impossible to tell apart.
problem: The Backlinks pane lists notes by name only, so several notes with the same name appear as identical rows that cannot be distinguished without opening each one.

relations.evidence: Same disambiguation goal; targets the Backlinks pane
Same path-context goal; keeps the core Backlinks pane and adds paths to rows
Same path-display goal; targets the Backlinks pane

summary: Plugin that shows each backlink's full file path in the Backlinks pane so notes sharing the same name can be told apart.
